submitted.rationale: EQE rose steadily as Sb increased along the rutile branch: 0.0026% at index 14, 0.0045% at index 19 and 0.0147% at index 22 (Cr0.23Sb0.77). XRD shows a single rutile CrSbO4-type phase near 1:1. Toward the Sb-rich end the lattice expands and a minor Sb-oxide phase appears from about index 20 onward. Index 22 has the highest EQE measured.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.0026%, lower. Near-stoichiometric rutile CrSbO4.
Measured EQE 0.0045%, about 3x lower than index 22.
XRD at index 5 shows a Cr2O3 secondary phase, and EQE falls toward the Cr-rich side. Not worth spending merit budget there.
